name: ACE-Step 1.5 — Text to Music
description: Generate a music track from a style prompt and optional lyrics using the ACE-Step 1.5 standard model.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Style / prompt
inputs.description: Genre, mood, instruments, BPM — e.g. 'upbeat electronic with piano, 120bpm'.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.label: Lyrics (optional)
inputs.description: Leave empty for an instrumental track.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.label: Quality steps
inputs.description: Higher = better quality, slower. 60 is a good default for the base model.
